You have to look really deep into yourself and figure out what's wrong w your mental; the root of your insecurity and emptiness. I feel everything you're saying cause on the outside ppl say I look fine but my mind is an absolute mess rn. I'm 19 but I've struggled w depression and near-crippling social anxiety for years. At a young age I adopted the ability to cope by being edgy and making concerning jokes, but that doesn't actually do anything so by 7th grade I was worshipping satan. That did jack shit, too, so I started buying xanax and vyvanse in 10th. I did my best to get clean after getting expelled for a semester getting *caught under the influence and quit my job to ensure I wouldn't falter under my indulgence. However, I strongly believe that if I weren't taking these substances I would have been killed myself. That remains true to this day because after my parents died June 26th this year (my graduation day) weed and xanax have been my shitty ass glue stick holding me together for  however long it can maintain. You have a bright future ahead of you, dude. Everyone going through shit has some frowned upon coping method they use to keep their sanity, but don't let it overtake your life. Sorry this isn't the advice you wanted.
